m85c839892f: You're the director of this show.
mc97249d201: Your kid gets a phone call from the North Pole. You get the full backstage tour — what's actually happening, how it's kept safe, and how to make the moment land perfectly.
mb7a0efe088: When your child calls, they're talking to a live AI performance of Santa — a video avatar with a warm, unhurried voice, holding a real two-way conversation in real time. Nothing is pre-recorded and no two calls are the same. Before the call, you tell us your child's name and, if you like, their age, city, wish list, and something good they did this year. Santa opens with their name and works those details in naturally — that's the moment jaws drop.
mf3441e5ee5: You control recordings. Calls are not recorded automatically. On supported calls, you can record the screen and both voices locally, then choose whether to save the video to Photos. Our call provider can retain conversation transcripts; account deletion removes them. (Full privacy policy.)
m38287c6686: Santa never asks for personal information. He's instructed not to ask where your child lives, what school they attend, or anything of the sort — you provide the personal touches, never the child.
m03802fe1ef: No gift promises. Santa is warm and encouraging about wish lists but never commits to delivering a specific present. That promise stays yours to make.
mfd6e2c312d: A parental gate stands in front of anything involving money or leaving the app — kids can't buy minutes or wander to the web.
ma847745d06: Calls have a natural end. Santa and Mrs. Claus calls can last up to six minutes; Comet calls up to three. Your available minutes also limit the length of each call.
m85164cc036: Fill in the wish list beforehand. One or two real items your child actually asked for. Hearing Santa already knows is the whole trick.
m014da0243f: Add a good deed. For example: "I heard you helped your little brother learn to ride his bike…" A real detail makes the conversation personal.
m1df9d91afd: Stay in the room. Partly for safety, mostly because you'll want to see their face. Prop the phone up rather than holding it — it feels more like a real video call.
ma246a10da5: Let the call end naturally. Santa wraps up on his own as time runs low. Resist the urge to stretch it — a great four-minute call beats a padded six.
m976301bd47: Ages 3 and up. Three-to-eight is the sweet spot for full belief; older kids often enjoy it as a delightful bit of theater with younger siblings.
m71018442b9: Our suggestion: "It's the way Santa makes video calls this time of year — he can't fly everywhere before Christmas Eve." Keep the answer in the world of the story. Dial Santa never breaks character on a call.
m8443476560: You buy a minute pack once — no subscription — and minutes never expire. Calls are metered by the second, and if Santa ever fails to answer or a call won't connect, those minutes come straight back. Anything ever feels off, support is a human who'll fix it fast.

m99f0dad0c6: In the app, open Parents → Account → Delete account, verify your email and confirm. You can check call-provider cleanup there too. Deletion removes unused minutes and does not automatically refund purchases. Contact us from your account email if you need help.

mb838650df8: Dial Santa ("we," "us") is a parent-directed entertainment app: a grown-up sets everything up and buys minutes, and a child uses it together with their parent or guardian. This policy covers the Dial Santa iOS app and this website.
m40313a7469: Parent email address. This is your account. We use it to sign you in (a one-time code, no password), attach your purchased minutes, and send purchase receipts. Joining the website launch waitlist is a separate, optional choice.
mc09bcb9f2d: Call personalization you provide. A child's first name, and optionally an age, city, wish list, or good deeds — whatever a parent chooses to enter. These exist so Santa can greet your child and hold a real conversation.
made1a5b86e: Purchase records. Which minute pack you bought and when. Payments are handled by Apple for in-app purchases and Stripe for website purchases — we never see or store card numbers.
m387272c049: Basic call records. When a call happened and how long it lasted, so we can meter minutes correctly and refund calls that fail.
ma073858370: The website waitlist is for adults. If you join, we save your email address, signup date, and the consent you gave so we can send you one email when Dial Santa launches. Joining does not create an app account or purchase anything. We do not add app account emails to the waitlist automatically or use the list for unrelated marketing.
ma18ceae4e1: Waitlist addresses are stored in our Railway database until we send the launch announcement or you ask us to remove yours. To leave the waitlist before launch, email hohoho@dialsanta.app. Deleting an app account also removes the matching waitlist address. We briefly store a keyed, unreadable version of the signup IP address to limit spam; it expires after one hour.
mccb7ce6ddb: The website uses your browser’s preferred languages to choose a supported language. If you choose a language yourself, we remember that choice in local storage on your device. We do not request your location for this. You can change the language using the website’s language menu.
m28cf44d09b: Calls are live conversations with an AI character. The updated app explains the data sharing on the parent email screen: choosing Continue authorizes AI call sharing after email verification. Existing users who have not given this permission receive a confirmation before an online call. Provider names and processing details are listed below. Permission is required before starting an online call and is separate from iOS microphone permission. If you decline, no AI call starts; offline Activities remain available. Your child’s voice is processed in real time so the character can hear and respond. The camera self-view stays on your device; it is not sent to the AI providers or our servers. An optional local recording includes that self-view.
me25492e528: Recording is off by default. Optional screen-and-voice recordings stay on your device. ElevenLabs voice recording is disabled; its agents are configured to delete conversation audio and transcript data with zero-day retention. This is not ElevenLabs' enterprise Zero Retention Mode. LiveAvatar can retain transcripts, session records and personalized contexts. Account deletion requests removal of ElevenLabs conversations and LiveAvatar contexts/events and verifies the LiveAvatar transcript is empty. It stops LemonSlice sessions; it does not verify deletion of any historical LemonSlice logs or media. Provider technical, security, billing and legally required records may have separate retention.
mf5c6cd5256: After permission, starting a call sends Dial Santa the child's first name, optional age, city, wish list and good deeds, and selected language. Our backend passes the relevant details to the providers below to personalize the conversation. Spoken words, transcripts and generated replies may also contain personal information. Please share only what you want the character to know.
mf1caa3ce51: Santa is designed never to ask a child for personal information, and never to promise specific gifts.
m499003f5b2: On supported calls, Record captures the call screen, including the camera self-view, and both sides of the conversation. A visible recording control lets you stop recording. Muting your microphone also mutes your voice in the recording. Recording stops when the call ends or the app goes into the background.
mf74b8c95d3: Recordings are temporary files on your device. Dial Santa does not upload them to our servers or use them for advertising. After the call, you can preview, delete, or choose Save to Photos. Saving requests permission only to add a video to your library, not to read your existing photos. If saving fails or permission is denied, the recording remains available on the call's end screen so you can try again.
mc817571199: Save a recording to Photos if you want to keep it. Unsaved recordings are removed when you discard them, leave the call's review screen after confirming deletion, or restart the app. Videos saved to Photos are controlled by your Photos and iCloud settings. Deleting your Dial Santa account does not delete videos you saved to Photos; delete those in Photos yourself.
m3d5a402f84: These companies support the app. The call providers receive the following data for the stated purposes:
m3a2ce6bb45: ElevenLabs processes microphone audio, transcripts and personalization to generate replies and voices for Santa, Mrs. Claus and Comet. Its language-model processing uses OpenAI with conversation and profile text, including when an alternative model is needed. HeyGen (LiveAvatar) receives generated speech to animate Santa and Mrs. Claus; a fallback call mode also processes microphone audio, transcripts and personalization there. LemonSlice (Infinity AI, Inc.) receives generated speech to animate Comet. Generated speech can repeat details shared during the call.
m3c041fb233: LiveKit transports Santa and Mrs. Claus calls; Daily transports Comet calls. They carry encrypted microphone audio, character audio/video, captions, transcript events and session identifiers. This does not include your camera self-view. Providers also process connection and service-operation information.
mfed83b1eb9: Apple, Stripe and RevenueCat — Apple and Stripe process purchases and receipts through their respective payment services. RevenueCat receives an opaque account identifier and Apple transaction information to verify and report in-app purchases. We do not send RevenueCat child profiles, voice recordings or call content. When you delete your account, we request deletion of its RevenueCat customer record.
m102f1748d9: Railway — hosts our servers and database (located in the United States).
m7eafcfedba: Meta — measures which Dial Santa ads led to app installs. Once, after a parent signs up and verifies their email, Meta's SDK in the app sends an install and app-open event with basic device information (such as device model, iOS version, language, time zone, and an app-specific anonymous ID). The SDK doesn't start again when the app is opened later. Meta receives this device's advertising identifier only if you allow tracking when iOS asks. Automatic event logging, automatic advanced matching, and Meta crash reports are turned off, and Meta's Limited Data Use setting is on. We do not send child profiles, names, ages, voice, call content, email addresses, account details, or purchases to Meta. Information Meta has already received is handled under Meta's own policies.
m7aacc42d86: Provider protections include encrypted transmission and the security, access and rights commitments in their applicable terms. The data-processing terms of HeyGen, ElevenLabs, LiveKit and Daily address processing instructions, confidentiality, security and subprocessors. Their scope and retention rules differ. We never sell personal information.
mf53da45aed: Dial Santa is built for parents to run. Accounts, purchases, and setup are done by an adult; a parental gate protects anything involving money, privacy controls, or leaving the app. We collect from children only what a parent enters on their behalf (like a first name), plus the real-time voice processing described above — with the parent's separate, explicit permission before an AI call starts. Dial Santa does not show third-party ads. Advertising measurement is accepted by the parent at sign-up, happens once after the parent's email is verified, can be turned off under Parents, and never receives child profile or call data. We follow the principles of COPPA: minimal collection, parental consent, no behavioral advertising to children, and parental control over deletion.
mbaf9fd3aa7: Delete your account: open Parents → Account → Delete account, verify your email and confirm. We remove your account email, minute balance and call records from our active database and clear the child profile and history on that device. Other signed-in devices are signed out and clear their local account data when they next contact our server. Call-provider cleanup runs automatically in the background and retries temporary failures. Cleanup usually takes a few minutes; temporary outages can take longer. Check Parents → Account for a completion confirmation, or contact support.
m52dd1d64b5: Sign out: open Parents → Account → Sign out. Purchased minutes remain with your email, while the child profile and local history are removed from that device.
mbf9e643098: See your data: contact support to request access.
m4ba066eb97: Withdraw AI permission: use the AI data-sharing control in Parents → Privacy & safety. This prevents future online calls until a parent gives permission again; your account and offline Activities remain available. Withdrawal does not erase data already processed. Use account deletion or contact support for deletion requests.
maf85d078dd: Advertising measurement: open Parents → Privacy & safety → Turn off ad measurement. Dial Santa then shares nothing more with Meta from that device, even if you sign in again, and you stay signed in. You can also decline Apple's tracking prompt, or turn off Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking, to withhold the advertising identifier. Some U.S. state privacy laws may treat sharing device information for ad measurement as "sharing" personal information; the Parents control is how you opt out on your device, and you can also email us.
m8d29181fca: Account deletion removes unused minutes and does not automatically issue a refund. Contact support for help with a refund.
m4a74443bc7: All traffic is encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS). Sign-in codes are stored only as one-way hashes and expire in 10 minutes. We keep account and purchase records while your account exists and as required for tax and accounting; call-metering records are kept only as long as needed for billing accuracy. After account deletion, we retain keyed account digests and payment references to prevent old credentials or duplicate payment notifications from restoring an erased account. Payment processors may retain transaction records. Temporary provider-erasure jobs retain the references needed to complete downstream deletion; they are removed after completion. Provider cleanup follows the limits explained above; separate technical, security or legal records may remain under provider terms.

launch_pricing_note: US App Store prices shown; local prices may vary. Buy minutes in the app. Santa is included; Mrs. Claus and Comet each have a separate US$0.99 unlock, plus call minutes.
launch_faq_live: Is it really a live call?
launch_faq_live_answer: Yes. The conversation happens live: your child speaks, and Santa responds to what they say. It’s an interactive video call with an AI Santa, rather than a prerecorded personalized message.
launch_faq_cost_answer: Dial Santa is free to download. Calls require purchased minutes, starting at US$2.99 for five minutes. There is no subscription.
launch_faq_length_answer: Santa and Mrs. Claus calls can last up to six minutes; Comet calls up to three. The available balance also sets the limit. Minutes are used by the connected second, and remaining minutes stay in your account.
launch_faq_age: Is a grown-up part of the experience?
launch_faq_age_answer: Yes. Dial Santa is designed for a parent or guardian to set up and supervise. Stay nearby, especially with younger children. You control profiles, purchases, and when the call ends.
